description: Check agent Git commands; allow ordinary local commits after staged-path checks, deny risky operations.

hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$guardRoot = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('Git guard: cannot locate repository'); exit 2 }; python (Join-Path $guardRoot 'scripts/agent_git_guard.py'); exit $LASTEXITCODE"
hooks.statusMessage: 检查 Git 操作安全性
